title: Special Edition: Keel and Filo's Unnecessarily Long Day
text: “Going for a walk with big bro today!”

So, I was just about to head out for my daily walk when big bro decided to tag along. Usually it’s Luna-chan or someone like that who comes with me, but she’s not here today. Every once in a while, big bro comes along on my walks, you know? Though he puts a collar on me, holds the leash, and says stuff like “so you don’t wander off to weird places” while we walk. There’s definitely something off about that!　I get mad about it, but no one—not Raphtalia-chan or anyone else in the village—takes my side, saying, “That’s just Keel for you.” But today, my big bro’s just tagging along like normal.
“Big bro! It’s such a nice day!”
“Yeah, you’re right, Keel.”
So, we went for a walk in the nearby meadow, and my big bro threw a ball for me, so we played fetch! Is my big bro in a good mood today? I mean, he’s actually playing with me.
“What’s for lunch today?”
“Hmm… Maybe I’ll bake a cake.”
“Cake! Yesss! Big Bro’s cake!”
Because of everything that’s happened, sweet things taste way better to me now, and just thinking about eating Big Bro’s delicious cake makes me so excited I can’t stop drooling!
“…I guess it’s about time we headed back to the village.”
“Yeah! Big Bro! You’ve gotta make that cake, okay?”
“Yeah.”
Just as we were about to head back to the village… I saw some Filolials by the side of the road, slumped over listlessly, leaning forward.
“Ugh…”
“Motoyasu, you’re so mean!”
“Here it comes, here it comes!”
“Kikku-kun…”
What’s going on? They seem to be complaining about Spear Guy—what’s the deal?
“What’s goi—”
“We’d better hurry back. The Filolials were probably playing some rough-and-tumble game with Motoyasu.”
“Really?”

It kind of looks like the Filolials are muttering complaints, though… It’s unusual for Spear-Guy. I did think that, but sometimes they play obstacle courses or other games with rules that allow attacks, so I’m not really sure. It’s happened before, and if there were really a problem, the Filolials would go protest to my brother anyway. So I didn’t give it a second thought and headed back to the village with my brother.
“Ah, that stung a little.”
“But I guess it can’t be helped.”
I passed by a friend from the village who was rubbing his arm as he said that.
“What’s going on? Did you hurt yourself or something?”
I thought to myself, “If you’re hurt, just talk to someone who can cast healing magic or my older brother, and the pain will go away in no time.” So I went over to ask.
“Oh, it’s Keel. Well, that’s… ah—”
“Keel, didn’t we talk about this before? Today—”
Just as my friend was about to answer my question and looked behind me, he suddenly gaped in shock, then for some reason broke into a forced smile.
“N-nothing. I just felt a little itch—”
Huh? Did something happen? I turned around to look behind me at my big bro, but he was just standing there—nothing seemed out of the ordinary.
“Oh, right. Were you out for a walk, Keel?”
“Yeah! Big bro said he’d make me a cake today.”
“Oh, that’s great!”
“Well, we’ve got work to do, so see you later!”
“Alright! See you later!”

There was a weird vibe in the air, but it doesn’t seem like anything really happened. Dessert for lunch today is cake! I can’t stop getting excited! Thinking that, I continue my walk through the village.

Along the way, my big bro casually moved ahead, so I just followed him. I don’t have any plans, for some reason, and I’m out for a walk with my big bro, after all. That’s what I thought, but… it looks like my big bro is heading toward Rat-san’s lab in the village. I wonder if he’s going to check on Mr. Rat or Wyndia? After all, keeping an eye on everyone in the village is kind of part of his job.
But… everyone in the village is rubbing or clasping their arms—what’s going on? It’s just… kind of weird, isn’t it? I wonder what it is… I’m getting a really bad feeling.
Yeah, it feels a lot like that strange vibe I get when my brother’s about to trick someone. It feels like I should get out of here fast.
“What’s wrong, Keel?”
“Huh? Oh… I just… I’m starting to get a weird feeling. Is my big bro up to something? Doesn’t the vibe feel different?”

If it were Raphtalia, she’d pick up on this vibe right away and warn my big bro. But for some reason, she’s not here. Even though she’s usually right by my brother’s side. Come to think of it, why isn’t Raphtalia with my brother today? As my suspicions started to grow, everything about this weird situation started to make sense. “I’ve got to get out of here right now!”—but no sooner had I thought that than my brother grabbed me by the scruff of the neck! My feet are off the ground!
“Big Bro! What are you doing?!”
“Ugh, just be quiet!”

I recognize this scenario! It’s just like that time when Imiya-chan came running back half-naked, her face bright red, and Big Bro grabbed me under his arm and carried me back home! You know, the rumor about how I’d be dragged into bed and Big Bro would do naughty things to me! In reality, it was just sleeping next to him, and I was supposed to bark and chase Atla-chan away if she showed up. ……Just like that time—which actually got my heart racing a little—my big brother scooped me up and dragged me into Rat-san’s lab!

“Big bro! What are you planning to do to me?! Raphtalia-chan! Help me! According to the order, Raphtalia-chan should go first! No, if Raphtalia-chan doesn’t go first, I’ll get killed! Raphtalia-chan!”
“Don’t say anything that might lead to misunderstandings! Be quiet!”

With a clatter, we entered Rat-san’s lab, and the village kids, the Filolials, and the monsters were all standing there, each placing a hand on some part of their body as if they’d just been subjected to something.
“Raf”
“Rafu”
“Tari”
“Lee-ah”
“Uuuugh… Atla, I held it in, big bro.”
“What’s the point of making such a fuss over something like this? I used to do it all the time, too. That said, you did quite well.”

Fohl-nii is being calmed down by a semi-transparent Atla-chan. What’s she doing to him? She’s not conducting some kind of human experiment, is she!? Am I going to get modified even further? I heard that since I’ve become the “Scythe Hero,” I can’t accept that kind of thing. Just as I was thinking that, my brother brought me into Rat-san’s examination room. Rat-san was there. It looks like Wyndia isn’t here.
“How are you doing?”
“Ah, Grand Duke… I’ve basically treated all the kids in the village. All that’s left are Gaelion, Keel, and Filo. Well, Gaelion will probably be taken care of by that girl.”
“The boys already received their treatment while Wyndia was away. Their parents’ personalities, that is.”
“Yes, they’ll cooperate without any trouble, won’t they?”
“Brother! What the heck is going on!　What are you doing to everyone in the village?! Woof woof! Voo!”

It looks like my brothers are doing something weird to everyone in the village. Raphtalia isn’t going to stay quiet about this! Rat-san has pulled out a syringe and is preparing some kind of medicine. What are they planning to do with that!? Are they going to give me a shot!? Is this some kind of experiment with a new drug? Just like when they used me for their cooking experiments. That food was super delicious, but this time it’s a shot, so I don’t want it!
“Ah, you ask what we’re doing? It’s a mass vaccination.”
“A mass vaccination!?”
I feel like I heard about this a few days ago. I don’t really get it, but everyone in the village was saying they were going to do it!
“I knew you’d completely forgotten, Keel. Just as I expected—it’s a good thing you’re such a dimwit. If you’d known what it was, I thought you’d have run away beforehand.”
“Is it that thing where you have to drink bitter medicine?”
“That’s a preventive medicine. Well, it’s pretty much the same thing. That one takes effect immediately, but it’s a formula with limited lasting power.”
“Then what about the Filolials we’ve encountered along the way!?”

“Ah… those were the ones Motoyasu treated. Since I figured the Filolials would definitely resist and run away if we tried to give them a shot, I showed Motoyasu a really long video of them suffering from various diseases—like Filolial distemper and Filolial heartworm.”

For some reason, my brother suddenly showed me a video on his crystal screen of the spear-wielding guy looking like his soul had been sucked out. He kept showing Kuu, Marin, Midori, and the Filolials one video after another of him turning the spear into a giant syringe and stabbing people with it. Does he actually carry that crystal screen around with him? What the heck are you using that for, bro?!
“Mokkun! Don’t point that thing at us!”
“Noooooo! I’m getting consumed!”
“What did you do to Motoyasu-san?!”
That’s awful. Those three-colored Filolials. Spear-Guy’s expression is completely lifeless. Hmm? The guy in the video is saying something.
“Kukuku… It’s useless. Right now, this guy has become the Demon of Vaccinations… no, the Hero of Vaccinations. I’ve hardened my heart.”
A close-up of the spear guy’s face—he looks like a wreck. We don’t need that kind of description. And seriously, bro, why do you look like you’re enjoying this a little?
“You demon!”
“Demon of the Shield!”
“Demon King of the Shield!”
“It’s been a while since I’ve heard those insults… Go ahead, Motoyasu.”
The footage continued to show the spear-wielding guy thrusting his spear into Kuu and the others as they trembled in fear and screamed in horror.
“Gyaaah!”
“Nooo! Help meee!”
“Gyaaah!?”
Kuu and the others, having been stabbed, slumped to the ground and protested. It showed the spear-wielding guy coughing up blood as he attacked the Filolials one after another!
“By the way, I showed him this footage.”

Rat-san had also shown me the crystal containing the footage she’d shown the spear-wielding guy. It featured Filolials staggering and growing weaker from high fevers, Filolials that were emaciated and in tatters, along with anatomical diagrams and footage explaining the causes. I don’t really get it, but I guess this is what they call research material on diseases or something? Won’t Spear Guy kill me if I show him stuff like this? On top of that, there were videos of Demi-Humans and Beastmen suffering from similar illnesses. Those look familiar.
“…Come to think of it, what about Luna-chan!?”
For some reason, Luna-chan isn’t here today. I was thinking, “Phew, at least I don’t have to deal with her clinging to me,” but given how things are going…
“Ah, I already took care of Luna early this morning. It’d be a hassle if she tried to protect Keel. I told Motoyasu to make sure she gets a good night’s sleep.”
So that’s why Luna-chan isn’t here today. She’d definitely protest if I got unfairly grabbed by my big bro.
“Got it? No help’s coming.”
“I get it, but why am I in this situation anyway?”
It just means I have to get a shot, doesn’t it! You could’ve just told me normally.
“Well, you’d probably refuse the shot and try to run away no matter what, wouldn’t you?”
So the reason I was put on the back burner is because he thought I’d put up a fight, right?
“Don’t make fun of me, big bro!”
Just how much does my “big bro” think I hate shots?! Stop treating me like a kid!
“But you’ve got a history, haven’t you? Raphtalia and your friends all said so.”
“Ugh…”

I can’t argue with that. Back in the peaceful days before the waves came, there was a time when I ran away with all my might right before I was supposed to get a shot. If you asked me if the adults caught me and I still didn’t put up a fight back then… I couldn’t deny it. But that’s not who I am anymore! I consider myself a grown-up now! Besides, the older guys are just looking out for us.
“Even if you’re a dog, you’re a hero, and if you resist recklessly, it could lead to a disaster. Just be a good boy and take the shot.”
“Got it?” my older brother ordered, and then Rat-san, holding the syringe, took one step, then another, toward me.
“You’ll give me cake when this is over, right?”
“Yeah, I promised.”

It’ll be fine, yeah… If I just count the patterns on the ceiling, it’ll be over in no time. I think to myself, “With a hero’s power, I should be totally fine against sickness, right?” but this is a piece of cake. It’s way easier than defeating that goddess who causes the waves. It’s not like they’re sticking it right in a sensitive spot or anything! Ah, but this is still pretty scary! Just as I was trembling… CRASH! With a loud bang, a shadow smashed through the window and burst into the room, accompanied by a “puff” sound. Then the shadow attacked my older brother, who was holding me, and my line of sight shifted rapidly.
“Sunatchikuroten!”
“Huh? What?”

“W-what’s going on?” I looked around and saw that, for some reason, Filo-chan was grabbing me by the scruff of my neck. I was being held by the guy—what just happened? I found out later that she’d snatched me away using her “Claws” Skills.
“What?”
The guy turned his gaze toward me and looked at the hand that had been holding me.
“Boo! Master, that’s so mean!”
With a quick backstep, Filo-chan shifted back into human form, grabbed me, and took a fighting stance facing my brother.
“Tch! So Melty and Raphtalia messed up… She’s a sharp bird.”
“We’re getting out of here, Keel-kun!”
“Huh? Wait, hold on a sec—W-waaaaaaaaaaaah!?”

Still holding onto me, Filo-chan burst through the window she’d smashed open and sped off. The scenery was changing at a terrifying speed. Even though I’d been enhanced in various ways as a Hero, Filo-chan had been too, so the speed was making my head spin.
“Oh no… they got away.”
“Don’t let them escape! Villagers! Punish these fugitives severely! A reward awaits whoever captures them!”
My brother’s voice boomed out, and an alarm blared from Rat-san’s lab. And just like that… a mysterious game of tag began. I mean, I don’t have a clue what’s going on either.
“Apparently, only Filo and Keel-kun haven’t gotten their vaccinations yet.”
“Ehh! That’s so unfair!”
“Everyone else has already gotten theirs!”
“But I heard we’ll get a reward if we catch them!”
“Ooh! Then let’s all go catch them!”
“Ooh!”
I could hear them say. It’s probably the Filolials.
“Filolial-sama! You just got your vaccination—you shouldn’t be doing any sudden exercise!”

I could even hear the spear-wielding guy warning the eager Filolials. But… maybe thanks to Filo-chan’s concealment and stealth Skills, we weren’t spotted, and their voices and the sounds of their movements gradually faded into the distance.
“Looks like they’re gone. That was close, Keel-kun.”
Filo-chan, who’d been watching the situation, turned her face toward me with a look of relief. Why did this even happen?
“Well, I didn’t really…”

It’s just a vaccination, right? I just need to tough it out. It’s super scary, but my big brother promised to make me a cake if I went through with it. It was supposed to be over just by counting the patterns on the ceiling.
“You’re so mean, Master! You’re teaming up with Mel-chan and Raphtalia-nee to trick Filo into calling me ‘ugly.’ You’re trying to do it, aren’t you?”
“Isn’t it necessary?”
“Boo! Filo hates shots! You’ll call me ‘ugly’ just like Spear Guy—I don’t know where you’ll call me that, so no way!”

Whoa… so Filo hates shots? Isn’t she the number one in the village? Wait a minute… am I getting dragged into this? Thinking about what’s coming next, the cake is definitely the better option here. Just as I was thinking that, a really delicious, toasty aroma wafted over.
“Filo, Keel, come out here quietly. Otherwise, look—there’s a special dish being served that only those who’ve gotten their shots can eat!”
I heard my brother’s voice. He must have rushed to make something that smells amazing just to lure us into the dining hall. Ahh, my mouth is watering. My big bro’s delicious cooking…
“Come on, say it.”
“Filo-chan and Keel-kun can’t eat this meal—!”
“Eeeh~~, poor things—!”
“Even though it’s so delicious—!”
The Filolials are being made to shout that at my brother. That’s cheating, bro! I mean, seriously, am I just getting caught in the crossfire here? I really want to eat that stuff over there, though…
“Boo!”
“Hey, Filo-chan, just go ahead and say ‘I give up’ anywhere—anywhere at all—and eat my brother’s delicious food, won’t you?”

It’s not like it’s stuck in some weird place. It doesn’t look like it’s stuck in his butt or anything, and the pain only lasts a second. Even if it hurts enough to make him cry, he’ll get a delicious meal, so he’ll snap out of it right away. Besides, that guy’s good at healing Magic anyway.
“No, Keel-kun! If you go out now, you’ll get caught! Then the Spear Guy will stab you!”

Does it really matter if the Spear Guy stabs me? Well, in the case of the Spear Guy, he’d probably just leave the spear stuck in me and blow me up, so that’d be a problem for me. He’d say something like, “I just blew those dog-pigs to smithereens!”… No, wait—the Spear Guy would call me by my first name if I were in my cool Beastman form. But… “To trouble my Father, and on top of that, elope with Filo-tan—that’s a crime worthy of a thousand deaths!” He’d probably say something like that and kill me. In that sense, he’s scary! After all, right now I’m on the run with Filo-chan. My inner brother keeps interjecting, “Since we’re both the same gender, no one would think we’re eloping,” but we’re talking about Spear-bro here, right? It’s not impossible, is it? When I answered that, my inner brother fell deep in thought. It is possible… Spear-bro.
“Anyway, we’re running away as far as we can, Keel-kun! Until our masters give up on giving Filo and the others those shots!”
With a “puff,” Filo-chan transformed into her Filolial form and plunged me into her chest feathers, just like Luna-chan used to catch me!
“Whoa! Let go, Filo-chan! Don’t go catching me like Luna-chan does! Let me out!”
“Go!　Filo and Keel-kun won’t give up! We’re definitely going to make it out alive!”
And just like that, my day of escaping the long vaccination ordeal with Filo-chan began… I mean, this is just a total disaster—I got dragged into Filo-chan’s escape!
Meanwhile, at that time…
“They’re not coming out, are they?”
“I thought they’d come out lured by the smell.”
“Those gluttonous lot are putting up a sneaky fight…”
“Rafu.”

At the village cafeteria, we were lying in wait for Keel-kun and Filo to come out. Of course, Lord Naofumi had said that if they surrendered willingly—after he’d cooked a dish with a very enticing aroma—he’d let them eat it. Even so, Filo and the others showed no signs of coming out… Filo and I were put in charge of keeping an eye on her in case she tried to run away, and sure enough, she did—or rather, she used some strange intuition and just ran off. Somehow, they found out that Naofumi-sama was going to deal with Keel-kun, so they rushed over and snatched him away… And now, after finishing his cooking, Naofumi-sama is—for some reason—sitting in a chair with Raph-chan on his lap, petting her. To make matters even stranger, the Spear Hero is sitting nearby on one knee with his head bowed. I mean… there are countries where people perform that kind of bow when having an audience with a king or something, but what on earth is going on here?
“Honestly, what a deplorable situation. Melty, even you let Filo slip away.”
“I was being careful, you know. To begin with, I never imagined Filo-chan would be such a kid who hates shots so much.”
“That might be Rat’s fault. When he first arrived, he was using that to subdue Filo.”
“I won’t deny that, but… monsters tend to really hate hospitals.”
“True. Well, there’s no reason for them to like them, after all. Keel was practically a dog—he noticed right away we were heading to the hospital.”
Naofumi-sama clicked his tongue again.

“No matter what anyone says, they’re heroes. If they put up resistance in the wrong place, it’ll turn into a disaster beyond a joke. We’ve already suffered massive damage in Zeltoble. We must avoid any further damage to our reputation.”
“You were the cause of that incident, weren’t you, Naofumi?”

“Shut up. It’s Gaelion and Chocolate’s fault. We can’t exactly make people who just got vaccinated do strenuous exercise… If we’d handled it a bit more gradually, we could’ve deployed more combatants.”
“Since they all got vaccinated at once, we can’t push them too hard, can we?”

According to Rat-san, strenuous exercise is off-limits after getting vaccinated. He said you never know what kind of problems might arise—from shortness of breath to who knows what else… Since Raph-chan and I were treated first, we’re mostly fine, but unfortunately, everyone else is temporarily unable to move.
“Boo! It’s so unfair that only Filo and Keel-kun got to skip the shots!”

“It’s not unfair. They’ll get their shots too. We’re treating everyone equally here. You guys, remember this: we can’t give everyone special treatment, but we can treat everyone equally—even if that means being harsh on everyone.”
“Eh…”
“Is that so?”
“Stop telling Filolial-sama and the others such unpleasant things.”

I get the feeling Naofumi-sama is getting into some kind of strange mood. I’m absolutely certain it’s because the Spear Hero is kneeling with his head bowed. He seems just like a subordinate swearing allegiance. I’ve seen a character like that in some kind of play.
“In any case, we must all get vaccinated equally. I’m not so lenient as to accept ridiculous excuses like, ‘If I get sick, I’ll just take some medicine.’”

Well, I actually think Lord Naofumi has a pretty soft side. After all, he had prepared a cake just in case Keel cooperated, and he didn’t try to lure him out by using the crepe tree that Keel cherishes as bait. …From what I heard, it seems Keel was just about to obediently get his shot when Filo snatched him away.
“Lord Naofumi, if it’s Keel, I think he’d come running out the moment you mentioned burning his crepe tree. That way, you could catch him easily.”
Atla… please don’t just keep quiet about things you’re deliberately not saying here. There was a chance Lord Naofumi might not have realized that, you know?
“That’s one option, but it’s strictly a last resort. Keel’s probably thought that far ahead, too. We can wait a little longer before exploiting his weakness.”
“Understood.”
“Atla, you too… no, never mind. Or rather, you’ve probably had plenty of those in your life so far.”

Atla-san looks like everyone else, but she’s in spirit form… so she’s exempt from vaccinations. There are people who’ve been stung even though they’re exempt, but well, Atla-san had a rough time back in the day, too.
“Naofumi, are you messing around or something?”
“It’s because of Motoyasu-san, you know.”
“Fuuuuh…”
Even the heroes are just watching Lord Naofumi’s antics.
“Well… Filo-chan and Keel-kun are really hanging in there, aren’t they? It feels like this is starting to resemble that peeping scandal I heard about.”
“A shot, huh. I wonder if people really hate it that much.”

Ark and Ho have also decided to just stand by and watch. It seems like you two could settle this right away, though. Especially since Ho is in a position to give orders to Filo. By the way, Ark didn’t so much seem to dislike getting the shot as he looked wary of something; he accepted the syringe on the assumption that he’d be the one administering it. But according to Rat, who actually performed the procedure, there was no sensation of injecting a living creature, and in Ho’s case, the needle apparently melted.

Still, Ho has a Band-Aid on his butt. Apparently, he was stabbed by the Spear Hero. Even in that condition, he seems to understand the threat level. However, it apparently had no effect, so it looks like he’s just jokingly wearing a Band-Aid on his butt. Something about how he saw it was no big deal and deliberately let them do it, or something like that.

I wonder if these two should be considered part of the group that received the injections… By the way, among the village children, Filo and Keel are the last ones left, but there’s talk that Fitoria should probably get it too.
“You didn’t like the shot, did you, Filo-chan? Ah, Big Sister, I really wanted to get antibodies from Naofumi-chan via a blood transfusion.”
Big Sister Sadeena… please rein it in a little. I can tell you’re saying something pretty gross.

“Stop saying such disgusting things. Anyway, those of us who can move will apprehend Filo. As for Keel, we’ll threaten him if he resists! For the sake of our secret society, Vaccination’s, ambitions, we’ll make no exceptions!”
“When did you start a secret society?”
“In Naofumi-kun’s case, isn’t it just for fun?”
“Anyway, let’s go, everyone! It’s hunting time!”
“Hah! As my Father commands!”
“Please don’t include the Spear Hero in this!”
And so… a long day began for Filo and Keel—who had escaped their vaccinations—and even for Ms. Fitoria, who was about to get her shot.
April Fools' Day
